props.intro: Automated Organic Content Engine is one of six systems we build. They are designed to connect, so nobody who raises a hand gets dropped between them.

props.text: Ten minutes of talking becomes a month of content.

You speak into your phone once. No studio, no script and no editing on your end. My team and I take that one recording and cut it into short videos, written pieces and captions, all in your own words. We line them up in one place for you to approve with one tap, and then they go out all month on the accounts you choose. You are not getting a list of ideas to go write yourself. You are getting finished pieces, with your face and your voice on them. And every one of them tells people where to go next, which is your website.

text.label: Text: Free before paid
text.value: Free before paid

text.label: Heading: Why free attention comes before paid attention.
text.value: Why free attention comes before paid attention.

text.label: Text: It used to cost money.
text.value: It used to cost money.

text.label: Text: For most of my forty years in business, if you wanted strang
text.value: For most of my forty years in business, if you wanted strangers to know your name, you paid for it. Radio, TV, a mailer, a sign. And somebody had to let you in. Most people could not even get into that space. That has been flipped on its head. Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube will put you in front of people for nothing, and a podcast costs next to nothing once somebody sets it up for you. None of that is new. What is new is that one person can now show up on all of them, steadily, without a payroll full of people behind them.

text.label: Text: Self-promotion, done for you.
text.value: Self-promotion, done for you.

text.label: Text: My team and I are a modern day talent agency. Being seen is
text.value: My team and I are a modern day talent agency. Being seen is free now. Knowing how to get seen, week after week, and get paid for it, is still a skill. Whatever you do for a living, you have to do self-promotion to make it work, and most people were never shown how. This system is the self-promotion, done for you. You talk about what you know. We make sure the right people see it, over and over, and we send them to the place where they can pay you.

text.label: Text: You did the hard part.
text.value: You did the hard part.

text.label: Text: You already have followers. Those people chose to watch you.
text.value: You already have followers. Those people chose to watch you. Nobody paid to push you in front of them. That is the most valuable attention there is, because it comes with some trust already built in. A person who followed you on purpose is partway to buying before you say a word. Paying to reach strangers while the people who already like you only hear from you now and then is doing it backwards. So we start with the crowd you have already earned.

text.label: Text: Free shows what works.
text.value: Free shows what works.

text.label: Text: Every video you put out is a small test that costs you nothi
text.value: Every video you put out is a small test that costs you nothing. Some of your stories make people stop, watch and come over to your website. Others get a polite nod and a scroll. Over time we learn which of your lessons make people move, and we make more of those. When advertising gets added later, as the sixth system, the money goes behind messages that have already proven themselves with your own audience. You never pay to find out whether an idea is any good.

text.label: Text: It keeps working.
text.value: It keeps working.

text.label: Text: An ad stops the day you stop paying for it. A video does not
text.value: An ad stops the day you stop paying for it. A video does not. A clip you put out this month can still be found long after, by somebody typing what you teach into Google. A podcast episode sits on your website for as long as you want it there. Every piece adds to a library with your name on it, and that library points at a website you own. That is the difference between renting attention for a week and building something that is yours.

text.label: Text: How it works
text.value: How it works

text.label: Heading: You own the accounts and the words. Ever
text.value: You own the accounts and the words. Every clip points back to your website.

text.label: Text: The social accounts are yours and stay y
text.value: The social accounts are yours and stay yours, and so is the website every clip points to. The face on camera is yours and the words are yours. We do not invent opinions for you or put a stranger's voice on your name. What we add is the part nobody has time for: turning one recording into a month of pieces, writing the captions and titles in the words your audience actually types, and getting them out on a schedule. If we ever part ways, the accounts, the website and everything we made stay with you.

text.label: Text: It also means we report on what your vid
text.value: It also means we report on what your videos sent to your website and what that turned into, not on how many people liked a clip. Attention pointed at a page that cannot catch it just wastes the attention, so if the site is slow or the follow-up is not answering, you will hear that from us before you spend another month recording.

props.text: What lands in front of you every month.

No promises about going viral, and no homework. You talk for ten minutes. This is what comes back, every month, without you chasing anybody for it. Nobody hands you an editing program to learn. Nobody asks you to write captions at midnight or remember which day something is supposed to go out. What comes back is a finished month, in your voice, waiting on your phone for a yes.

props.body: You sit down once and talk about what you teach. What comes back is the whole month: short videos, written pieces, captions, in your voice, not a stranger's.

props.text: Most coaches, authors and influencers know they should be putting more out, and never get past the part where somebody has to make the thing. Recording is the easy part. It is the cutting, the captions, the titles and the remembering that wear a person down, and that is where good intentions go quiet. That part is now somebody else's job. AI employees do the heavy lifting day and night, my team checks the work before it reaches you, and I am on your account personally. Yours is ten minutes and a yes.

text.label: Text: Seven to ten times
text.value: Seven to ten times

text.label: Heading: Almost nobody buys the first time they see you. This is how
text.value: Almost nobody buys the first time they see you. This is how you get to the tenth.

text.label: Text: Think how you buy.
text.value: Think how you buy.

text.label: Text: Think about the last time you paid real money to somebody yo
text.value: Think about the last time you paid real money to somebody you found online. You probably did not do it the first day. You watched a few of their videos. Maybe you listened to them talk for a while. You saw their name again the next week. Somewhere along the way they stopped being a stranger and became somebody you felt you knew. People need to see you and hear from you seven to ten times before they trust you enough to pay. Your followers are no different from you.

text.label: Text: Where it breaks down.
text.value: Where it breaks down.

text.label: Text: Most coaches, authors and influencers show up in bursts. A s
text.value: Most coaches, authors and influencers show up in bursts. A strong week, then a quiet month, because a launch, a client or plain life got in the way. Look at that from your follower's side. They saw you a few times and then you went silent. They were not telling you no. They simply never got to seven. The trust you were building cooled off, and the next time they see you it has to start over from the beginning.

text.label: Text: The schedule keeps count.
text.value: The schedule keeps count.

text.label: Text: With this system running, a month of videos, clips and writt
text.value: With this system running, a month of videos, clips and written pieces is made and approved before the month begins. Something with your face and your words goes out on a steady schedule whether you are busy, traveling or flat on your back with a cold. So the follower who found you in the first week sees you again, and again after that, without you remembering to make it happen. The seven to ten times now happen on a calendar instead of on your willpower.

text.label: Text: The podcast goes deeper.
text.value: The podcast goes deeper.

text.label: Text: A clip is a short hello. A podcast episode is a person choos
text.value: A clip is a short hello. A podcast episode is a person choosing to sit with you for a long stretch, in the car or on a walk, hearing how you think and how you talk. That builds a kind of familiarity a short video cannot. So you get both. The clips keep you seen often. The episodes let people get to know you. And both end in the same place, which is your website, where your e-book and your program are for sale.

text.label: Text: Who shows up.
text.value: Who shows up.

text.label: Text: By the time somebody comes to your website, they are not a c
text.value: By the time somebody comes to your website, they are not a cold stranger. They have heard your stories. They know what you believe and how you explain things. They came on purpose. That is a very different conversation from trying to convince a person who has never heard of you. What you teach already works. This is what gives people enough time with you to believe it.

props.text: Why this one is number two.

Content is what sends people to you, and it is free. The website is what catches them when they arrive, which is why it comes first. Send a crowd at a page that cannot catch them and you have shown more people the weak spot. Think of a restaurant. You do not hand out flyers until the kitchen can feed the people who walk in. So we build the website first, with your e-book and your podcast on it. Then we turn on the content. And the systems after it answer, follow up and book, so the people your videos send over are met by something when they get there.

text.value: When your videos go out steadily, people respond. A comment under a clip. A private message asking how to work with you. A form filled in on your website late at night. Each one of those is a person raising a hand, and getting hands raised is the whole job of this system. It is also the spot where most sales are lost. The hand goes up while you are asleep or with a client, and by the time you see it, the interest has cooled.

text.label: Text: System 3 catches it.
text.value: System 3 catches it.

text.label: Text: That is why the third system in the Revenue Engine is Speed
text.value: That is why the third system in the Revenue Engine is Speed to Lead. An AI employee answers every comment, message and form in seconds, day or night, while the person still cares. The content engine gets the hand raised. Speed to Lead makes sure somebody is there when it goes up. One without the other is half a system, and half a system is what most people with an audience are running today.

Six parts, one engine, each one handing off to the next.
